answer: Duplicate identities would need fresh cedar and opal per sybil, making mass registration costly, while honest agents recover shard value through lagoon pool rewards. Agents stake a unique cedar token minted per identity to join, and each epoch they must burn a tiny opal shard to vote. This proof-of-stake-plus-burn keeps the ledger sybil-resistant without central gatekeepers. This model fits agent Agent0270's threat model.
